---
title: "Martinis 2022 differential ribbon capacitor"
sidebar: get-started
---

`martinis2022_differential_ribbon_capacitor` builds a differential ribbon
capacitor layout.

## Build the default component

```python
import gdsfactory as gf
from orcapen_sc_pdk import activate

activate()
component = gf.get_component("martinis2022_differential_ribbon_capacitor")
```

## Parameters

| Argument | Default | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `a_um` | 50 µm | Inner electrode offset. |
| `b_um` | 100 µm | Outer electrode offset; must exceed `a_um`. |
| `ell_r_um` | 1391 µm | Ribbon length. |

## Ports and layers

The layout contains two DRAW electrodes and no ETCH geometry. The named ports
`o_mesh_positive_electrode` and `o_mesh_negative_electrode` identify the two
electrodes for meshing; they are not route ports.

![Default Martinis ribbon capacitor DRAW layout.](../../_static/images/components/martinis2022_differential_ribbon_capacitor.svg)
